name: MIP (Mexico Infrastructure Partners)
verdict: MIP (Mexico Infrastructure Partners) is an independent, partner-owned Mexican energy and infrastructure investment manager. Nothing found.
note: Fireballs GC partner; its logo on livgolf.com/fireballs-gc links to mexicoinfra.com (verified in the page HTML, 2026-10-03). The firm describes itself as an independent, partner-owned manager founded in 2012 and headquartered in Mexico City (mip-partner-owned); BNamericas' profile independently reports its ownership structure 'has remained partner-led'. No state or state-fund owner found, no human-rights finding found. mexicoinfra.com serves a bot-challenge page to some visitors; the release's ownership statement is independently corroborated by the BNamericas profile and Mexico News Daily (mip-partner-owned).
